name: Kelp bass (calico)
bag: 5 combined w/ sand bass (max 4 barred sand bass)
size: 14 in TL or 10 in alt length
notes: Combined limit with barred and spotted sand bass. Fillets min 7.5 in w/ 1 in sq skin patch. Alt length = base of first dorsal spine to tail tip. Sub-limit of 4 barred sand bass sunsets Jun 1, 2028.

name: Barred sand bass
bag: Max 4, within 5 combined w/ kelp & spotted sand bass
size: 14 in TL or 10 in alt length
notes: 4-fish sub-limit (2025 rule, sunsets Jun 1, 2028) inside the 5-fish bass combo. Fillets min 7.5 in w/ 1 in sq skin patch. Cornell LII text is stale (2013) and omits the sub-limit; booklet and CDFW summary carry it.

name: Spotted sand bass
bag: 5 combined w/ kelp & barred sand bass
size: 14 in TL or 10 in alt length
notes: Shares the 5-fish bass combo (only barred sand bass has the extra 4-fish cap). Mostly bays/harbors - check MPA and harbor rules. Fillets min 7.5 in w/ 1 in sq skin patch.

name: White seabass
bag: 3; only 1 south of Pt Conception Mar 15 - Jun 15
size: 28 in TL or 20.5 in alt length
season: All year (1-fish limit Mar 15 - Jun 15 in SoCal)
notes: Whole SoCal region is south of Pt Conception: 1 fish/day Mar 15-Jun 15. Fillets min 19 in w/ 1 in sq patch of silver skin. Alt length: CCR text says 20.5 in; booklet table prints 21.5 and CDFW web summary 20 - regulation text governs. Some MPAs (SMCAs) allow WSB by spear only - check MPA.

name: Giant (black) sea bass
notes: May not be taken off California; any incidental catch must be returned immediately where taken. Also named in §28.90 as a species spear gear may not be used on. Only fish legally taken in Mexico (2/angler/trip, Mexican permit as proof) may be possessed.

name: California sheephead
season: All year for divers & shore; boat anglers Mar 1 - Dec 31
spear: OK; divers exempt from Jan-Feb boat closure
notes: Jan 1-last day of Feb closed to boat-based hook-and-line. Divers may take year-round, but during Jan-Feb NO fishing gear other than spearfishing gear may be aboard the vessel/kayak. Fillets min 6.75 in, entire skin intact. Nearshore stock - CDFW may change rules in-season (§52.10).

name: Ocean whitefish
notes: Open year-round in all depths; not tied to groundfish season. Fillets min 6.5 in with entire skin intact.

name: CA scorpionfish (sculpin)
season: All year, all depths (except Groundfish Exclusion Areas)
notes: Federal groundfish but exempt from season/depth closures; not in the RCG 10. No take in the 8 SoCal Groundfish Exclusion Areas (offshore banks, §27.50). Boat/kayak: descending device must be aboard when possessing (§27.20(b)(2)). Venomous spines. Fillets: entire skin attached.

name: Garibaldi
notes: May not be taken or possessed (state marine fish). Also expressly excluded from spearfishing gear in §28.90 and bow-and-arrow in §28.95. Bright orange, common on every SoCal reef - do not shoot.

name: Gulf & broomtail grouper
notes: Both species may not be taken or possessed; regulated together in §28.12 and named in the §28.90 spear-gear exclusion. Rare warm-water visitors to SoCal - if unsure of a large grouper ID, do not shoot.

name: Other groupers (cabrilla)
notes: Groupers OTHER than broomtail, gulf and giant sea bass (e.g. spotted cabrilla) fall under the general finfish limit. No species-specific section. Fillets: 1 in sq skin patch. Positive ID essential - broomtail/gulf grouper and giant sea bass are no-take.

name: Opaleye
notes: No species-specific section in Title 14 or the 2026 booklet; general finfish limit §27.60(a) applies (20 total, max 10 of one species). Fillets: 1 in sq skin patch, any size.

name: Halfmoon
notes: No species-specific section in Title 14 or the 2026 booklet; general finfish limit §27.60(a) applies (20 total, max 10 of one species). Fillets: 1 in sq skin patch, any size.

name: Sargo
notes: No species-specific section in Title 14 or the 2026 booklet; general finfish limit §27.60(a) applies (20 total, max 10 of one species). Fillets: 1 in sq skin patch, any size.

name: Black croaker
notes: No species-specific section in Title 14 or the 2026 booklet; general finfish limit §27.60(a) applies (20 total, max 10 of one species). Fillets: 1 in sq skin patch. Do not confuse with white croaker (OEHHA consumption advisories in parts of LA/OC).
